p: Perine remains a contributing part of the running back rotation.
The coach praised his game but gave no hint of a bigger role, so he is a secondary option for now.
Samaje had a good game as well
Taylor highlighted Perine's missed-tackle touchdown run as a big moment, which hints at red zone involvement.
Perine's strong run-game finishing could earn him continued run-game work alongside Chase Brown.
Perine appears to have had the hot hand in a run-heavy win, but Taylor framed the backfield split loosely, so treat the touch share as unsettled.
